review: Full source read: typed root/target shape extraction, indexed candidate query, conservative fallback and persistent connection Reader.

findings.insight: pattern_index.candidates already queries exact typed rewrite heads plus wildcard roots under pinned snapshot membership, with conservative no-index fallback. Contract rewrite_proposals can reuse it instead of scanning every nested operation occurrence.
findings.next: Add indexed and absent/legacy-index contract discovery regressions; keep bounded fallback scanning and normal object authentication and proof replay.

findings.insight: candidates and Reader.candidates pass limit directly to SQLite unlike Store.query; negative SQL LIMIT would be unbounded, and Reader does not explicitly begin a read transaction.
findings.next: Inspect all callers and test resource limits and concurrent snapshot/index refresh before claiming an admission or consistency defect.

limits: Discovery index shape and root membership are scheduling hints, not proof authority.
No new schema is needed for typed-head contract acquisition.
No performance measurement accompanies this source review.
